shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g '"'!dist'"' -g '"'!build'"' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,115p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'ls -a && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination TextInput Select Button Modal Label Popup Avatar && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.md && rg -n '"'^#{1,4} .*([Tt]able|Pagination|TextInput|Select|Button|Modal|Label|Popup|Avatar)'"' /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.md | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination TextInput Select Button Modal Label Popup Avatar && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import urllib.request
try:
 data=urllib.request.urlopen('https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt').read().decode()
 open('/tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.md','w').write(data)
 print('Documentation fetched:',len(data),'characters')
except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__,str(e))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(Table|TextInput|Popup|Modal|Checkbox|Label)/(README|.*d.ts)"'$'"' | head -40 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Popup/Popup.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"fetch('https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>{require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.md',t); console.log('Fetched',t.length)}).catch(e=>console.log(e.message))\" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -140 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -170 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -110 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'Table|Pagination|TextInput|Button|Modal|Checkbox|Popup|Label' /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.md | head -100 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons 2>/dev/null && rg -n -- '--g-button-(background|text|border)|--g-color-base-(positive|info|utility)|--g-color-text-positive' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json');console.log(p.version)\" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md | head -70 && rg -n -- '--g-button-(background|text|border)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -22 && head -c 900 node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/metadata.json"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/icons@2.23.1 && node -e \"fetch('https://gravity-ui.com/icons').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>{require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/gravity-icons.html',t); const m=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/metadata.json').icons;console.log(m.filter(x=>/magnifier|plus|arrow-down-to-line|sliders|ellipsis|persons|person-plus|circle-check|chevron-down|circle-question|bell|arrow-up-right|xmark|envelope|clock|moon|sun|chevron-right/.test(x.name)).map(x=>x.componentName).join(', '))})\""

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'useTheme|updateTheme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/theme/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ThemeProvider/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -85 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.css | head -55 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.css | head -75"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -140 && head -65 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.css && head -75 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.css'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- src/main.tsx package.json index.html && rg -n 'disableDataSorting|onSortStateChange|selectedIds|onSelectionChange|currentPage|filterAndSort|useThemeValue|onToggleTheme' src/App.tsx"
